component: Account Hub automation startup suppression phases

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The follow-up removes the automation-only guard and returns true for the suppression preference, leaving the Boolean caller to perform post-wizard loading. isFirstRun also honors that preference, but checks account/calendar/address-book state first. The test moves AddrBookManager's forbidden phase from idle to first paint. Later accepted code changes the Boolean contract, so the original return flow and a reported Marionette fix remain separate from current initialization and runtime proof.
title: The startup suppression follow-up returns control to the caller after checking first-run state
